pages.text: Bring a ranged option and watch your footing — the Aether is a $(t4)Tier 4$() dimension: aerial combat on floating islands, and Deep Aether's biomes grow on the same islands (it has no dimension of its own).

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Three dungeon bosses — the Slider (Bronze), the Valkyrie Queen (Silver), the Sun Spirit (Gold) — each drop a Simply Swords unique and a Too Many Bows bow; the Eye of the Storm (Brass Dungeon) is the Aether's apex.$(br2)$(bold)Hazards:$() thin air above y 180 (Weakness, unless your armour carries Aether Acclimation), vertigo when sprinting above y 200, and an updraft that slows a fall into the void once. Aether mobs move fast; swets, whirlwinds, cockatrices and zephyrs grow with the Tier 4 curve.
$(bold)Materials:$() Zanite, Gravitite and Ambrosium are Aether-native; Deep Aether adds Skyjade and Stratus, and $(bold)Aethersteel$() ore hides in its holystone. Death here costs 22% durability.

$(bold)No guide book.$() The Aether is exploration-driven — the dungeons each have discoverable lore, and the $(bold)Book of Lore$() found in them gives in-world context.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Slider in the Bronze Dungeon — the Aether's first boss and your shot at Thunderbrand.$()
